tasks.description: Implement is_prime(value: int) -> bool. Return true only for integers greater than one with no positive divisors other than one and itself. Handle negative values, zero and one as false. Use only the Python standard library.
tasks.tests:
from solution import is_prime
import unittest

class PrimeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_small_values(self):
        self.assertFalse(is_prime(-3))
        self.assertFalse(is_prime(0))
        self.assertFalse(is_prime(1))
        self.assertTrue(is_prime(2))
        self.assertTrue(is_prime(3))
        self.assertFalse(is_prime(4))
    def test_larger_values(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_prime(97))
        self.assertFalse(is_prime(99))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
